x-domainry-decision-table.author: Standalone <type>[!] DSL without Object-only semicolon modifiers.
must_not: Copy max_length, unique, indexed, numeric bounds, or other Object-only modifiers from a conceptual or external entity.
Add a fake project Object field only to satisfy source inference.
x-domainry-decision-table.when: The value is owned by the Action or by a Foundation capability and is not persisted in a project Object field.

x-domainry-decision-table.author: Use the exact same stable field key, type, and Object-only modifiers as that Object field.
must_not: Bind by a differently named field, synonym, prefix, suffix, or Action verb.
Copy only some of the Object field's modifiers.
x-domainry-decision-table.when: The Action field is the same persisted business datum as a field on the owning Object or an Object in handler.access.

identity_owned_non_profile_inputs.rule: Use standalone DSL because Identity, not the business Profile Object, owns these values.

profile_bound_inputs.rule: Reuse Object-only modifiers only when the bound Profile Object has the exact same field key and compatible field contract.
